preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
For each test case, n must be between 1 and 100,000.
For each test case, k must be between 0 and n.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, k in test_cases) <= 2 * 10**6
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases must not exceed 2,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(A[i] == i for i in range(n)) else True
postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, output -1.

postconditions.expression: len(set(A)) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in A)
postconditions.description: The output permutation A must contain all integers from 1 to n exactly once.

postconditions.expression: sum(A[i] == i for i in range(n)) == k
postconditions.description: The number of indices for which A[i] == i must be exactly k.
